source_text: extra futuram operum retributionem ex multa parte liberum arbitrium formam voluit implere iudicii? Iustissime enim sibi - sicut definis - bonus homo malusque committitur, ut et bonus se fruatur inoboedientiam carnis quae in carne concupiscente adversus spiritum apparet, diabolico vulnere contigisse
pass_a_gloss: Outside futuram operum retributionem from many-things parte free decision formam voluit implere iudicii? Iustissime for to-himself - as definis - good human-being evil-and committitur, so-that/as and good himself fruatur inoboedientiam of-flesh which in in-flesh concupiscente adversus Spirit apparet, diabolico wound contigisse.

lemmas.lexica: LS liber=free; Blaise unde liberum est abstinere
LS arbitrium=judgment, free decision; Blaise liberum arbitrium

pass_b_english: There can be absolutely nothing that is both sin and punishment for sin.
Augustine reports Julian accused him of contradictory statements: that bodily intercourse was invented by the devil, and that the law of sin opposing the mind’s law was imposed by God as punishment.

choices.why: Glossary default: arbitrium is the decision-power, not a later Augustinian/Reformation free-will locus.
Julian distinguishes nuptiae from concupiscentia; do not flatten to 'lust' as a nature-sin substance.
Augustine's quoted claim that the unbaptized remain under the devil; keep the personal devil, not 'evil'.
rejected: under Satan (name not in the Latin here)

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded. Julian is not first-English.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Contra Iulianum / Against Julian), including authorities Julian quoted; Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded. This row is Augustine's report; Pass A glosses only the Julian words recoverable here.
